messages:
anna: Heads-up — CI on main is red for the prompt_render_v2 golden snapshot after the recent JSON escaping tweak. Failing job: https://ci.example.com/builds/4567 :frown:
matt: :eyes: can you paste the minimal diff or the failing stack?
anna: small excerpt from the golden diff — looks like extra backslashes in the serialized turn text\n```
- expected: \"Hello, how can I help?\"
+ actual:   \"Hello, how can I help?\\n\"
```
anna: test name is TestPromptRender::test_chat_turn_serialization
sara: hmm that looks like newline escaping changed, maybe the change that touched string normalization slipped through. can someone rerun CI to confirm it's deterministic?
anna: requested a rerun: /rerun build 4567
ci-bot: Rerun started for build 4567 — queued on runner-08. ETA ~4m
matt: I'm happy to bisect if rerun confirms flaky or persistent. Quick ask: does anyone recall touching the serializer->escape_json patch? @jen?
jen: I reviewed that patch, but only the js-side escaping. this looks like python-side encoder adding explicit \n escapes. cc @matt might be the change landed in runtime/serializers.py
matt: ok i'll try a local reproducer: `pytest tests/eng/test_prompt_render.py::TestPromptRender::test_chat_turn_serialization -q -k chat_turn` and run `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` to keep things deterministic
matt: if local repro works, next step is `git bisect` between  6f2b1a4..main; command i'll use:\n```
git bisect start main 6f2b1a4
# mark good/bad as I go
```
anna: note: if it's a behavior change intended by the escaping patch, we should add a regen + eval to dev docs, not silently accept. but first confirm CI.
sara: quick triage checklist: 1) rerun CI (done) 2) try local pytest with seed (matt) 3) capture full failing snap via `scripts/dump_snap.sh prompt_render_v2` 4) if bisect points to serializer, revert candidate and run unit tests
matt: rerun finished and it's still failing on runner-08. grabbing full snap now.
ci-bot: Build 4567 (rerun) finished — status: failed. Failing job: runner-08/test-06
matt: uploaded snap diff to the thread: https://artifacts.example.com/snaps/4567/prompt_render_v2.diff
jen: looking — diff shows `\n` got double-escaped in some cases. i'm going to try a tiny patch to the encoder to preserve raw newlines for chat turns and run unit tests.
anna: thanks. keep notes here so we can decide regen vs revert. ping me if you want me to open the rollback PR.
matt: will update with bisect result or PR link in ~30m. :thumbsup:
